defects: Zombie-pick detection read picks in draft/validated with select * and no limit. 38,939 rows qualify in production; PostgREST returns 1,000, so the check silently saw a fraction of the population.
API /health took ~13.9s against Command Center's ~8s health timeout: 39 serial schema-drift HEAD requests (a new client per call) and one serial outbox lookup per candidate.
what_this_lane_repairs.repair: PickRepository.listPromotedByLifecycleStates filters server-side on promotion status and target, orders created_at then id, and pages past the cap with readAllOrderedPages. Repositories without it fall back to paging listByLifecycleStates. Stranded CI proof fixtures are reported in fixtureCount and a warning, never counted as zombies; a real zombie still makes /health 503. Outbox lookups and schema-drift probes run with bounded concurrency (8); a successful drift result is reused for 60s per runtime, and a failed one is never cached.
what_this_lane_repairs.why_the_fixture_classification: A complete read finds 8 stranded picks in production, every one a CI proof fixture. Counting them would hold /health -- and the api container healthcheck that probes it -- at 503 on synthetic data, and prescribe a requeue that enqueues delivery work for fixtures. The markers are the ones Command Center's isTestFixturePick already applies.

The existing Track Only mutation control still passes with the generalised guard-marker regex.
Full workspace unit suite on this tree.
